**[id 16]** The passage states "studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted" — so **D) Traffic Flow**.

**[id 17]** "Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children" — so **A) If the cells are germ-line**.

**[id 18]** "an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses" — so **A)**.

**[id 19]** "the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century" — lenses and magnification existed for thousands of years, so **D) Making telescopes**.

**[id 20]** "signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style" — so **D)**.

**[id 21]** "The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes" — so **D) There are no absolutes in learning**.

**[id 22]** "Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams" — so **A) Both teams are expected to perform at the same level**.

**[id 23]** Content theories deal with internalized needs (C), environmental effects on actions (B), and understanding what appeals to people (D) — but desires are internalized *as they mature*, not new desires materializing in adulthood, so **A)**.
